This vault publishes investment essays with Quarto instead of Substack. Memos, alphas, and full reports stay in the repo; only `posts/` go on the site.

```bash
make new-post NAME=your-slug
make preview
make publish
```

See [docs/quarto.md](../../docs/quarto.md).
